passages.p1: Hi Anna, I have some news - I have [[1]] to a new town! It is quite [[2]] but I like it a lot. There is a lovely little [[3]] near my house where I buy all my food. I really [[4]] my new home because it is quiet and friendly. Would you like to come and [[5]] me one weekend? We can [[6]] at the train station and I will show you around. Love, Kate
passages.p2: Put the sentences in the correct order to make a story. The first one is done for you.
passages.p3:
A. Long before recorded music existed, festivals were almost the only chance most people had to hear musicians play live.

B. Different regions slowly developed their own instruments, so the music of a mountain village could sound completely unlike that of a fishing town nearby.

C. Much festival music was never written down; it passed from parents to children simply by being played and remembered.

D. As people moved to cities and later travelled between countries, they carried their songs with them and mixed them with new ones.

E. When microphones and loudspeakers arrived, a single band could suddenly perform to a crowd of thousands rather than a few dozen.

F. Today, huge festivals are broadcast online, allowing someone on the other side of the planet to watch as if they were there.

G. Despite all this technology, many musicians say nothing will ever replace the feeling of playing together in the same field under the sky.

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you _____ to need help, just ask the teacher.
questions.explanation:
If' mang nghĩa 'mỗi khi/nếu' nên dùng hiện tại đơn 'happen', không dùng 'would' trong mệnh đề if.
[TD]Dịch: Nếu bạn tình cờ cần giúp đỡ, cứ hỏi cô giáo.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He _____ be rich, but he is not very kind to people.
questions.explanation:
May' diễn tả sự nhượng bộ ('có thể đúng là... nhưng...').
[TD]Dịch: Anh ta có thể giàu, nhưng anh ta không tử tế với mọi người lắm.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If only he _____ smoking when the doctor told him, he would be healthy now.
questions.explanation:
If only' + quá khứ hoàn thành 'had given up' diễn tả tiếc nuối về quá khứ, kéo theo kết quả hiện tại.
[TD]Dịch: Giá mà anh ấy đã bỏ thuốc khi bác sĩ khuyên, thì bây giờ anh ấy đã khỏe mạnh.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

She _____ her assistant of leaking the confidential merger details to a rival firm.
questions.explanation:
Cấu trúc 'accuse sb of + V-ing' (buộc tội ai làm gì) đúng giới từ, khác 'blame sb for'.
[TD]Dịch: Cô ấy buộc tội trợ lý của mình đã làm rò rỉ chi tiết thương vụ sáp nhập mật cho một công ty đối thủ.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

It is reported that the old house _____ to a new owner.
questions.explanation:
Bị động hoàn thành 'has been sold' diễn tả việc ngôi nhà đã được bán.
[TD]Dịch: Có tin rằng ngôi nhà cũ đã được bán cho chủ mới.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

That _____ Tom at the door. He said he would come tonight.
questions.explanation:
Will be' diễn tả sự suy đoán chắc chắn về hiện tại (hẳn là).
[TD]Dịch: Đó hẳn là Tom ở ngoài cửa. Anh ấy nói sẽ đến tối nay.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He made the decision without asking anyone, and his team _____ it ever since.
questions.explanation:
Hiện tại hoàn thành 'have regretted' với 'ever since' diễn tả sự tiếc nuối kéo dài từ quá khứ đến nay.
[TD]Dịch: Anh ấy đã quyết định mà không hỏi ai, và đội của anh hối tiếc kể từ đó đến giờ.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

In the past, people _____ to bow when they met someone important.
questions.explanation:
Used to' diễn tả phong tục/thói quen từng tồn tại trong quá khứ nay đã mất.
[TD]Dịch: Ngày xưa, mọi người thường cúi chào khi gặp người quan trọng.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He arrived _____ for the meeting because his flight had been delayed for hours.
questions.explanation:
Cần tính từ/trạng từ 'late' (muộn); 'lately' nghĩa 'gần đây' nên không hợp ngữ cảnh.
[TD]Dịch: Anh ấy đến muộn cuộc họp vì chuyến bay đã bị hoãn nhiều giờ.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ majority of the students passed the test.
questions.explanation:
The majority of' dùng mạo từ xác định 'the' khi nói về đa số một nhóm cụ thể.
[TD]Dịch: Đa số học sinh đã đỗ bài kiểm tra.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

We would have been late _____ the taxi driver's fast driving.
questions.explanation:
But for' nghĩa là 'nếu không có', dẫn danh từ để chỉ nguyên nhân giả định.
[TD]Dịch: Chúng tôi đã bị muộn nếu không nhờ tài xế taxi lái nhanh.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

You _____ told me you don't eat meat before I cooked dinner!
questions.explanation:
Might have + V3' diễn tả lời trách móc về việc lẽ ra nên làm.
[TD]Dịch: Lẽ ra bạn nên nói cho tôi biết bạn không ăn thịt trước khi tôi nấu bữa tối chứ![/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you _____ me, I think this movie is not very good.
questions.explanation:
Câu điều kiện thực diễn tả ý kiến hiện tại, dùng hiện tại đơn 'ask' trong mệnh đề if.
[TD]Dịch: Nếu bạn hỏi tôi, tôi nghĩ bộ phim này không hay lắm.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ you happen to see Lan at school, please give her this book.
questions.explanation:
If + happen to' diễn tả tình huống tình cờ; dùng 'If' cho điều kiện thông thường.
[TD]Dịch: Nếu bạn tình cờ gặp Lan ở trường, hãy đưa cho cô ấy cuốn sách này.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

You can borrow my flat in Vienna _____ you water the plants and feed the cat.
questions.explanation:
As long as' nêu điều kiện (miễn là), phù hợp ngữ cảnh cho phép có kèm điều kiện.
[TD]Dịch: Bạn có thể mượn căn hộ của tôi ở Vienna miễn là bạn tưới cây và cho mèo ăn.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ the bridge been built stronger, it wouldn't be damaged now.
questions.explanation:
Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện: 'Had + chủ ngữ + V3' thay cho 'If... had' diễn tả giả định trái với quá khứ.
[TD]Dịch: Giá như cây cầu được xây chắc hơn, thì bây giờ nó đã không bị hỏng.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

Direct: 'You shouldn't have spent so much money on that toy.' Reported: Mom told me I _____ so much money on that toy.
questions.explanation:
Shouldn't have + V3' đã ở quá khứ nên giữ nguyên khi tường thuật.
[TD]Dịch: Mẹ nói lẽ ra tôi không nên tiêu nhiều tiền vào món đồ chơi đó.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I found a girl _____ voice is really beautiful.
questions.explanation:
Whose' là đại từ quan hệ chỉ sở hữu, thay cho 'the girl's voice'.
[TD]Dịch: Tôi tìm thấy một cô gái mà giọng hát rất hay.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I will lend you my bike _____ that you return it by Friday.
questions.explanation:
On condition (that)' nêu điều kiện ràng buộc (với điều kiện là).
[TD]Dịch: Tôi sẽ cho bạn mượn xe đạp với điều kiện bạn trả lại trước thứ Sáu.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

My friend _____ going to the new restaurant for dinner.
questions.explanation:
Động từ 'suggest' đi với V-ing (không dùng 'suggest sb to do').
[TD]Dịch: Bạn tôi đề nghị đi ăn tối ở nhà hàng mới.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ have a quick coffee somewhere before catching the late train?
questions.explanation:
Shall we...?' dùng để đưa ra lời đề nghị, rủ rê cùng làm gì đó.
[TD]Dịch: Chúng ta đi uống cà phê nhanh đâu đó trước khi bắt chuyến tàu muộn nhé?[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

You look tired!' 'Yes, I _____ for the test since this morning.'
questions.explanation:
Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn 'have been studying' diễn tả hành động kéo dài từ 'since this morning' đến hiện tại.
[TD]Dịch: 'Trông cậu mệt quá!' 'Ừ, tớ đã ôn thi từ sáng đến giờ.'[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He was writing his essay when the lights went off, and he realized he _____ to save it.
questions.explanation:
Quá khứ hoàn thành 'had forgotten' diễn tả việc quên xảy ra trước thời điểm mất điện.
[TD]Dịch: Anh ấy đang viết bài luận thì đèn tắt, và anh nhận ra mình đã quên lưu bài.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

The plan has been _____ for several weeks.
questions.explanation:
Cụm danh từ 'under consideration' (đang được xem xét) tránh thể bị động.
[TD]Dịch: Kế hoạch đã được xem xét trong vài tuần.[/TD]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

The proposal was _____ rejected by the entire board without further discussion.
questions.explanation:
Trạng từ 'flatly' (thẳng thừng) đi với 'rejected'; 'very/rather' không bổ nghĩa cho động từ kiểu này.
[TD]Dịch: Đề xuất bị cả hội đồng thẳng thừng bác bỏ mà không bàn bạc thêm.[/TD]

The study of the world and how things work
questions.explanation:
science (noun) the study of the world and how things work (môn học nghiên cứu về thế giới tự nhiên và cách mọi thứ vận hành)

for (preposition) showing who is meant to get or use something (dùng để chỉ ra đối tượng hoặc mục đích mà điều gì đó được dành riêng)
This gift is for you. (Món quà này là dành cho bạn.)

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Who is your best friend, and what is he or she like?
questions.sampleAnswer: My best friend is Lan. We met at secondary school and now we work near each other. She is kind, funny, and very helpful. She always listens when I have a problem. We often have coffee at weekends because we like talking and laughing together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What are you wearing today? Describe your clothes and say why you chose them.
questions.sampleAnswer: Today I am wearing a blue T-shirt, black jeans, and white trainers. I also have a light jacket in my bag. The weather is warm this morning, so I do not need a thick coat. I chose these clothes because they are comfortable for work and travelling.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What did you do yesterday?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yesterday, I went to work in the morning and had lunch with two colleagues. After work, I bought some vegetables at the market. Then I went home, cooked dinner, and called my sister. I was tired, so I watched a short film before I went to bed.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: In this picture, I can see a busy train station platform. There are many people waiting for a train. Some people are standing near the edge of the platform, and others are sitting on benches. Most of them are looking at their mobile phones. One woman is holding a small bag, and a man is carrying a backpack. A few people are talking to each other, but they are also checking their phones. In the background, a large train is arriving at the platform, or it is waiting there. The station looks crowded and noisy. I think the passengers are waiting for the doors to open. They are probably going to work, school, or home.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Tell me about the last time you went on a trip or travelled somewhere.
questions.sampleAnswer: The last time I went on a trip was two months ago. I went to Da Nang with my sister for three days. We travelled there by plane because it was fast and comfortable. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. We swam in the sea, ate seafood, and took many photos. I really enjoyed the trip, so I want to go there again.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Why do you think many people look at their phones while they are waiting or travelling?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think many people look at their phones when they are waiting or travelling because they feel bored. A phone helps them pass the time. They can watch videos, listen to music, read the news, or talk to friends. Also, some people need to check maps or train times. I do this too when I am on a bus, but I try to look around sometimes.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Compare these two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I can see some construction workers on a building site. They are wearing yellow helmets and bright safety vests. They are working together near some scaffolding and a crane. It looks like early morning or late afternoon. Their job is busy and hard because they need to carry things and build safely. In the second picture, there is one person walking on a path in a green field. The sun is low, and the place looks quiet and beautiful. The person is alone and maybe taking a break. Both pictures show people outdoors. However, the first picture is in the city and has a group, but the second is in nature and has one person. Construction work is physical, while walking is relaxing.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Would you prefer to work outdoors or in an office, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I would prefer to work outdoors because I like fresh air and natural light. I do not want to sit at a desk all day. For example, I enjoy walking outside after school or work, so an outdoor job could make me feel active. However, I know outdoor work can be hot, rainy, and tiring. An office is more comfortable, but I would choose outdoors.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Do you think physical or manual jobs are respected enough in your country? Why or why not?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think manual jobs are respected, but not enough in my country. Builders, cleaners, drivers, and farmers do very important work every day. We need them to build homes, keep places clean, and bring food to shops. However, some people think office jobs are better. I disagree because manual workers often work long hours and do difficult physical tasks. They should get fair pay and more respect.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

Tell me about the most recent gift you received, who it was from, and what the occasion was.
questions.sampleAnswer:
The most recent gift I received was a blue water bottle from my sister. She gave it to me last month on my birthday. It is not very expensive, but I like it a lot because I use it every day. My old bottle was small and sometimes leaked in my bag. This new one is bigger and keeps my water cold. My sister also wrote a small card for me, so I felt very happy.

I like both handmade gifts and gifts from shops, but I prefer handmade gifts. They show that the person spent time making something for me. For example, my friend once made a birthday card with photos of us. It was simple, but I still keep it in my room.

Yes, I am planning to give a gift to my friend Lan soon. Her birthday is next week. I want to buy her a small notebook and some nice pens because she likes writing lists and drawing. I will also make a simple card for her.
